findings_qualitative.value: Dust and molecular gas are extremely compact (~1 kpc), consistent with a compact core about to quench

evidence.quote: We measure for the first time the size of the dust and molecular gas emission of GMASS 0953 that we find to be extremely compact ($\sim$1 kpc).

claims.hypothesis: GMASS 0953 is a compact star-forming progenitor of a compact quiescent galaxy
claims.experiment: Measure sizes, gas mass and depletion time from ALMA
claims.result: r~1 kpc, gas fraction 0.2, tdepl~150 Myr
claims.finding: It will rapidly exhaust gas and become a compact QG

evidence.quote: imply that GMASS 0953 is experiencing an episode of intense star-formation in its central region that will rapidly exhaust its gas reservoirs

claims.hypothesis: The molecular gas is in a rotating disk

evidence.quote: Kinematic analysis of the CO(6-5) line shows evidence of rapidly-rotating gas

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Merger in coalescence rejected as unlikely due to no two nuclei in HST image

evidence.quote: this picture seems unlikely based on the absence of two distinct nuclei in the core of the high-resolution HST/ACS image
